description: Optional static activation scales for Option B (NVFP4). No pack is shipped with the repository: ComfyUI's NVFP4 linear derives an activation scale per activation when input_scale is absent, so conversions are complete and calibration-free without one. Install a pack here only to bake static input_scale tensors in.

schema.activation_amax: object mapping quantized layer name (e.g. 'blocks.0.attn.qkv_proj') to the maximum absolute activation value observed at that layer's input across all calibration cases
